newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 26.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - March 26.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Wednesday and main factors likely to affect trading.

* Views were divergent on the performance of the market. Shares are seen trudging further into negative territory on Wednesday on a knee-jerk reaction to the U.S. Fed raising interest rates for the first time in two years, said Joel Santillan, research head at Asiamerit Securities Inc.
* But Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc research head Noel Reyes said the market has discounted the widely-expected rate rise.
